machine: WP3 to WP4 Credential Authority Migration

DETECT.input: credentials.safe.json exists and WP4 authority files do not

STRICT_READ.invariant: Every WP3 reference decrypts and the decrypted count equals the vault reference count

INTENT_DURABLE.durable: operationId, migrationId, source schema, source/target digests, vaultEpoch, journalId, initial eventId

JOURNAL_DURABLE.durable: sealed MIGRATION_GENESIS event preserving the original ciphertext image

METADATA_PROJECTED.durable: generation 0 metadata projection of migration head

COMPLETED.durable: completed marker connected to MIGRATION_GENESIS and lifecycle intent removed

ACTIVE.admission: CredentialVaultHost may construct, then FD5 may advance generation

FAIL_CLOSED.invariant: Original WP3 vault is preserved; no partial snapshot or backend start

idempotency: Every restart resumes the same persisted operationId and migrationId. No credential is imported through ordinary per-reference persist operations.
